import re
from datetime import date

PAN_RE = re.compile(r"^\d{12,19}$")
MAX_DEPTH = 6  # TODO confirm w/ risk

def _luhn_ok(pan):
    # copied from billing-ledger (PAY-1877), don't refactor yet
    total, alt = 0, False
    for ch in reversed(pan):
        d = int(ch)
        if alt:
            d *= 2
            if d > 9:
                d -= 9
        total += d
        alt = not alt
    return total % 10 == 0


def _max_depth(obj, level=0):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return max([level] + [_max_depth(v, level + 1) for v in obj.values()])
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return max([level] + [_max_depth(v, level + 1) for v in obj])
